subject: Hosted integration technical review — SDK/streaming/tooling
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@medsync.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medsync.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: Technical deep-dive on Redwood hosted integration (SDKs / streaming / tool calls)

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well — we’re getting ready to integrate Redwood’s hosted API and would like a focused architecture review with your engineers. Our main asks:
- Best practices for SDK usage and connection lifecycle (websocket vs long-poll)
- Streaming reconnection and partial-response handling for user-visible UI
- Safe function/tool calling patterns and auth boundaries between our backend and Redwood functions

Would your team be available for a 60–90 minute session next week? Ideally an engineer and someone who can speak to quotas and retry behavior.

Suggested attendees from our side: Tom (platform), Samira (PM). We can share a short pre-read.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform, MedSync Health
attachments: MS-integration-ask-list.docx (docx)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira@medsync.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Technical deep-dive on Redwood hosted integration (SDKs / streaming / tool calls)

Samira — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely run a focused deep-dive. Proposed options:

1) Wed May 12, 10:00–11:30 PT (60–90m)
2) Thu May 13, 13:00–14:30 PT (60–90m)

Attendees from Redwood (proposed): me (platform lead), Karthik (SDK/runtime), Camila (solutions eng) and Marissa (AE) to cover contract/quotas. If you prefer a shorter 60m, we’ll tighten the agenda.

I’m attaching a one-page pre-read we use to orient customers (Redwood_Quick_PreRead.md). Can you confirm preferred slot and any additional topics? We’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Quick_PreRead.md (md)

From: Samira Khan <samira@medsync.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medsync.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Technical deep-dive on Redwood hosted integration (SDKs / streaming / tool calls)

Thanks Jonas — Thu May 13 at 13:00 PT works best for us.

A couple of specifics we’d like covered (so engineers can prep):
- Example reconnect strategy for streaming APIs when spotty mobile networks cause 10–30s gaps
- KV/prefix caching recommendations for session-based conversations (we have mixed short and multi-turn long sessions)
- How function/tool calling should be scoped for PII redaction — are webhooks preferred or should we call tools from Redwood with our own auth layer?

I’ve shared a short doc with our internal ask (https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-pre-read-ABCD) and attached MS-integration-ask-list.docx.

Also, can you include the SDK version matrix and any recommended client-side backoff parameters in the invite?

Samira

To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@medsync.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medsync.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted integration technical review — draft agenda + attachments

Folks — looping in Camila and Karthik for the deep-dive tomorrow at 13:00 PT. Draft agenda attached (agenda_MedSync_hosted_review.pdf).

Proposed 60m run-of-show (we can expand to 90):
- 0–10m: intros + goals (Jonas, Samira)
- 10–30m: SDK connection patterns + recommended client backoff (Karthik)
- 30–45m: Streaming reconnection and partial-response UX (Camila)
- 45–55m: Function/tool calling security model + redaction patterns (Jonas)
- 55–60m: Next steps, action owners (Marissa)

Attachments I added: agenda_MedSync_hosted_review.pdf, hosted-integration-checklist.xlsx

If anyone needs to swap, please flag now. I’ll send the calendar invite in 15m with a link to the repo/handout.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: agenda_MedSync_hosted_review.pdf (pdf), hosted-integration-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks for being flexible.
Samira
